source: docs/CONTROLS.md (parsed table), cross-checked against `hmda verify --governance` output

controls.assertion: Protected-class fields are excluded from model inputs by an explicit allowlist, not by hoping no one adds them.
controls.sr_11_7: Model development and implementation: model inputs are deliberate and documented (principle named in words, no clause cited)
controls.osfi_e_23: Model design and development: inputs are justified and documented (principle named in words, no clause cited)

controls.assertion: A neighbourhood racial-composition field is excluded as a proxy for race, not merely the race field itself.
controls.sr_11_7: Model development: known input weaknesses and proxy effects are identified rather than assumed away
controls.osfi_e_23: Model design and development: proxy and unintended-bias risk in inputs is addressed

controls.assertion: Post-decision pricing fields cannot become features, so the model cannot learn the answer from the outcome.
controls.sr_11_7: Model development: data quality and appropriateness for the stated purpose
controls.osfi_e_23: Model design and development: data appropriate to the model's stated use

controls.assertion: Train and test are split by time, never randomly, so no future row informs a past prediction.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation, outcomes analysis: performance is measured out-of-sample in a way that reflects real use
controls.osfi_e_23: Independent review and validation: performance evidence reflects the intended use

controls.assertion: Every challenger score ships beside a benchmark baseline score; no public function returns the challenger alone.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation: benchmarking against an alternative is a named core element of outcomes analysis
controls.osfi_e_23: Independent review and validation: challenge against alternatives

controls.assertion: `run_eval` refuses an in-memory frame with no source label, so a sample number cannot print under a national or fixture label it did not come from.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: results are documented with the data they came from
controls.osfi_e_23: Model lifecycle governance: outputs are traceable to the data used

controls.assertion: `mitigate.prepare` refuses an in-memory frame with no source label, same reason.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: results are documented with the data they came from
controls.osfi_e_23: Model lifecycle governance: outputs are traceable to the data used

controls.assertion: `recourse.run_study` refuses an in-memory frame with no source label, same reason.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: results are documented with the data they came from
controls.osfi_e_23: Model lifecycle governance: outputs are traceable to the data used

controls.assertion: `explain.run_explain` refuses an in-memory frame with no source label, same reason.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: results are documented with the data they came from
controls.osfi_e_23: Model lifecycle governance: outputs are traceable to the data used

controls.assertion: Every data source states its own scope and row count in a label that every command prints.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance and documentation: the data behind a result is stated, not implied
controls.osfi_e_23: Data: the data used by a model is identified and documented

controls.assertion: Sampling is seeded and reproducible, so a quoted number can be regenerated.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: documentation sufficient for an independent party to reproduce the work
controls.osfi_e_23: Independent review and validation: a reviewer can reproduce the result

controls.assertion: A group below the minimum-count floor is suppressed and explicitly not-a-number, never silently dropped and never reported as zero disparity.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation: limitations of the result are identified rather than hidden
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations are documented and communicated to users

controls.assertion: The raw disparity and the controlled disparity are always returned together; no public function returns the raw gap alone.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation, conceptual soundness: a result is not presented without the adjustment that qualifies it
controls.osfi_e_23: Independent review and validation: conclusions carry their qualifications

controls.assertion: The "Race Not Available" share is reported beside every race disparity, so the reader sees the coverage behind the number.
controls.sr_11_7: Model development: data quality and coverage limitations are surfaced with the result
controls.osfi_e_23: Data: known data-quality limitations are disclosed

controls.assertion: Sentinel codes are never silently cast to a number; a sentinel becomes null, not a 1,111,000-dollar income.
controls.sr_11_7: Model development: data quality controls on model inputs
controls.osfi_e_23: Data: data quality is assessed before use

controls.assertion: Every exclusion appears as its own row in the row-count waterfall, naming the column and the rule that dropped the rows.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance and documentation: the transformation from raw data to analysis set is reviewable
controls.osfi_e_23: Data: data preparation and exclusions are documented

controls.assertion: The input schema is asserted stable across activity years; a header change is a hard failure, not a silent shift.
controls.sr_11_7: Ongoing monitoring: changes in inputs or environment are detected
controls.osfi_e_23: Ongoing monitoring: input stability is monitored over time

controls.assertion: Every ingested file carries a deterministic SHA-256 record, so the data behind a number is identifiable after the fact.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: documentation and auditability of model data
controls.osfi_e_23: Model lifecycle governance: data lineage is retained

controls.assertion: Year-over-year population stability is monitored on the model-input allowlist and reported as a count of shifted columns.
controls.sr_11_7: Ongoing monitoring, a named core element of validation
controls.osfi_e_23: Ongoing monitoring and performance review

controls.assertion: The drift threshold is a named constant, not a magic number chosen at a call site.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: thresholds are set by policy and documented
controls.osfi_e_23: Model risk framework: thresholds and tolerances are defined, not ad hoc

controls.assertion: Drift is reported to users as a shifted-column count; no raw PSI value and not even the word "PSI" reaches the user-facing sentence.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance: model output is communicated in terms its audience can act on
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations and results are communicated to users in usable form

controls.assertion: A statistic with no approved plain-English translation is refused, never guessed at.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance: reported model results are the ones policy allows, not improvised
controls.osfi_e_23: Model risk framework: reporting follows a defined standard

controls.assertion: The mitigation technique registry is capped at exactly three techniques, one per pipeline stage; a fourth turns a test red.
controls.sr_11_7: Model development: scope of the exercise is fixed and documented
controls.osfi_e_23: Model design: the model's scope and boundaries are defined

controls.assertion: Every mitigation line reports the fairness gain, the accuracy cost and the margin cost together; a gain never ships without its cost.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation, outcomes analysis: performance is reported with its trade-offs, not selectively
controls.osfi_e_23: Independent review and validation: results are reported completely, including adverse findings

controls.assertion: The per-group threshold technique carries a LEGALLY CONTESTED warning naming it as disparate treatment on its face in the US, measured for completeness and not presented as approved practice.
controls.sr_11_7: Model use: known constraints on the acceptable use of a result are stated with it
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations, including legal and regulatory constraints, are documented

controls.assertion: No mitigation output may be described as deployed, live, or in production; every report header states it is an offline counterfactual study over historical applications.
controls.sr_11_7: Model use: the actual use of the model is stated and not overstated
controls.osfi_e_23: Model lifecycle: deployment status is explicit; an unapproved model is not described as in use

controls.assertion: Every mitigation result is measured against the same unmitigated baseline, so the three techniques are comparable.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation: benchmarking is against a common reference
controls.osfi_e_23: Independent review and validation: comparability of evidence

controls.assertion: The economic assumptions behind the margin number live in a config file and are printed in the output header with an ILLUSTRATIVE banner, so the profit number is falsifiable.
controls.sr_11_7: Model development: assumptions are documented and their effect on output is shown
controls.osfi_e_23: Model design: assumptions are documented, justified, and their sensitivity understood

controls.assertion: A null or out-of-range economic assumption is refused rather than silently defaulted.
controls.sr_11_7: Model implementation: input validation, failure is loud rather than silent
controls.osfi_e_23: Model design and development: input validation and controls

controls.assertion: No protected attribute is offered to an applicant as an actionable recourse lever.
controls.sr_11_7: Model use: the result is constrained to the use it is fit for
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations and appropriate use are documented

controls.assertion: A recourse group below the count floor is flagged and gets no number, rather than being dropped.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation: limitations of the result are identified rather than hidden
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations are documented and communicated

controls.assertion: The explainability pack states that drivers are descriptive of the sample, not causal claims about the model's treatment of a group.
controls.sr_11_7: Model validation: the interpretation of model output is bounded by what the evidence supports
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations are documented and communicated to users

controls.assertion: The explainability run is deterministic across two full runs, so an explanation quoted today reproduces tomorrow.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: documentation sufficient for an independent party to reproduce the result
controls.osfi_e_23: Independent review and validation: a reviewer can reproduce the result

controls.assertion: Every explainability driver label resolves to a data-dictionary entry; no unexplained raw column name is surfaced to a reader.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance and documentation: a complete data dictionary supports the model record
controls.osfi_e_23: Data: model inputs are defined in documentation

controls.assertion: The CLI states on every disparity output that a flag is a statistical disparity warranting review and NEVER a finding of discrimination.
controls.sr_11_7: Model use: the permitted interpretation of the output is stated with the output
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations and appropriate use are communicated to users

controls.assertion: No individual lender is ever named as discriminating; flagged lender identity is an internal artifact only.
controls.sr_11_7: Model use: constraints on the disclosure and use of model output
controls.osfi_e_23: Model limitations and appropriate use are documented

controls.assertion: The model card states verbatim that this model is not used to make credit decisions.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance and documentation: a model record states intended and out-of-scope use
controls.osfi_e_23: Model rationale and design: intended use and exclusions are documented

controls.assertion: Every figure and table in the report carries a lineage record: source file, checksum, SQL file and commit.
controls.sr_11_7: Governance, policies and controls: documentation and auditability of reported results
controls.osfi_e_23: Model lifecycle governance: results are traceable to their inputs
